scripts.docs:prepare: node scripts/copy-openapi.mjs && npm run floor-plan:render -- examples/garage-layout.yml --floor ground --output docs/website/static/img/floor-plans/garage-layout-ground.svg && npm run floor-plan:render -- examples/garage-layout.yml --floor upper --output docs/website/static/img/floor-plans/garage-layout-upper.svg
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:prepare && docusaurus build docs/website
scripts.docs:check: npm run floor-plan:validate && npm run openapi:check && npm run docs:build
scripts.docs:start: npm run docs:prepare && docusaurus start docs/website
scripts.docs:preview: npm run docs:build && docusaurus serve docs/website
